race.comment: LAST CLANSMAN (9) finished fifth last start, beaten 4.5 metres at Menangle over 1609m. Can travel in a nice spot from this draw and wait on the sprint lane if necessary. Finds a suitable assignment and will be a major force. ONE PINEVALE HILL (5) was in the money at Menangle two runs ago before finishing ninth at her latest appearance over 1609m at Menangle, beaten 23 metres. Has the class to take this out. TRIUMPH STRIDE NZ (2) is looming as a real threat after a better effort last start, finishing second at Menangle over 2300m. CASUALCONNECTION (6) is worth another chance after a last-start eighth over 1609m at Menangle six days ago.
